Agda The induced square of mapping animae

mappingOut

Definition, checked

  mappingOut : {A B C D : CAT Γ} {l : MAP A C} {r : MAP B D}
    (s : Square l r) (E : CAT Γ)
    → Cone (mapPre {D = E} (Square.source-map s)) (mapPre l) (Map D E)
Proof / implementation
  mappingOut {l = l} {r} s E = record
    { left = mapPre r ; right = mapPre (Square.target-map s)
    ; match = (mapPre-comp l (Square.target-map s)) ⁻¹ ∙
        (mapPre⁼ (Square.cell s) ∙ mapPre-comp (Square.source-map s) r) }

Remark 1.8.2. We do not assume in the present metatheory that arbitrary pushouts of categories exist. We do not need this as a metatheoretic axiom, although such pushouts exist in all intended models of our theory. We will eventually prove that the synthetic category \(\Cat \) of small synthetic categories admits small colimits, which in particular provides pushouts of small categories.

Proposition 1.8.3. A commutative square of categories

If the left-hand square is a pushout square, then the right-hand square is a pushout square if and only if the outer rectangle is a pushout square.

Agda The specified outer rectangle

comp-square

Definition, checked

  comp-square : {A B A′ B′ A″ B″ : CAT Γ}
    {f : MAP A B} {f′ : MAP A′ B′} {f″ : MAP A″ B″}
    → Square f′ f″ → Square f f′ → Square f f″
Proof / implementation
  comp-square {f = f} {f′} {f″} Q P =
    square (source-map Q ∘ source-map P) (target-map Q ∘ target-map P)
      ((comp-assoc f (target-map P) (target-map Q)) ⁻¹ ∙
        ((target-map Q ◁ cell P) ∙
          (comp-assoc (source-map P) f′ (target-map Q) ∙
            ((cell Q ▷ source-map P) ∙
              (comp-assoc (source-map P) (source-map Q) f″) ⁻¹))))
    where open Square
